Connect your brush head to the  brush handle and dampen it. While the cleaning cycle is happening, the LED light on the side of the base will turn from white to blue and pulse. Once the cleaning cycle is complete, it will turn back to solid white. Your brush will also charge while it is sitting in the dock, provided that the dock is connected to a power source.

Caring for the Sonic Toothbrush Replacement Heads:

Always rinse the brush head and bristles after each use. Change your brush heads every 3 months at least.

Partridge berry is an evergreen plant growing as a non-climbing vine, no taller than 6 cm tall with creeping stems 15 to 30 cm long.
